digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler Jira adapter package structure
propositions: Extract Jira-family-general units from adapters/jira/ into a new adapters/jira_family/ package with public names and acyclic import rules

Move identity.py wholly, split probe.py (classifier moves parameterized; probe() stays), and split jira_fields.py by symbol (sanitizers move, some contract-parameterized; maps move; Cloud-side construction remains)
Eliminate duplicate status/priority map definitions by making adapters/jira_family/ the single source of truth, adopting the outbound_fields value for 'deleted' -> 'Done'
Pin and enforce the import contract: jira_family/ imports from neither adapters/jira/ nor adapters/jira_datacenter/, and no sibling adapter imports jira_family/ except via its public interface
Update all internal importers and mock.patch strings to point at new paths; acli*.py changes only in import lines, no logic or __all__ changes
Prove all J1 characterization oracles pass unmodified (one import line re-pointed, zero assertions changed) and no re-export shims remain at pre-move paths
